THE ACT ON ACQUISITION OF LAND (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Reference Number : HANGU/3/2/1/108. Reference Number of the Land and Parliamentary Reforms : 4-3/9/2013/WS/479.

I, hereby inform that the Government intends to acquire the dependence of the following land for the purpose of building the Brake Pressure Tank No. 1A of the Rikillagaskada Water Supply Scheme of the Rikillagaskada Water Supply Project in the Nuwaraeliya District Cluster Water Supply Project, under Sub Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. Description of the land dependence to be acquired : Lot No. 01 Lot Number 01 of Plan No: N 3291 of Surveyor General. Name of the Land: Rahathungoda Watta (Rutland Division); Description: Open barren land. There is a brake pressure

tank; Claimant: Janatha Estate Developments Board, No. 55/75, Vauxhall Lane, Colombo 2; Extent: 0.0173 Hectare. All those who make claims or other connections to the above-named land, must be present before me by themselves or by the persons who have been authorized in writing at the Hanguranketha Divisional Secretariat Office at 1.00 p.m. on the day of 21.08. 2019. Further, they must communicate to me in duplicate the nature of their title / ownership to this land, the details of claiming for compensation for this land, the amount claimed, and the method of calculating such amount , before 14.08.2019. The deeds for claims have to be forwarded to at the interview. I.M. SENANAYAKA, Divisional Secretary, Hanguranketha. At the office of the Divisional Secretary, Hanguranketha. 15th July 2019 08-202

AMENDMENT LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : EMDS/LND/05/ACQ/02/09. Ministry of Land Reference Number: 4-3/15/2013/VE/619. IN the notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) which was published by me in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2107/46 dated 25.01.2019 regarding that Land Acquisition under Village Expand in Adoluwa Division in Embilipitiya Divisional Secretary’s Division in Rathnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province. In here Plan No. R/EMB/2018/181 was incorrect. I, here by inform that above should be corrected as FVP No. 882 Supplement No. 28 Sheet No. 28 as per the Survey Plan prepared by the Surveyor General.
PRASANGA UDAYAKANTHA, Divisional Secretary & Acquiring Officer, Ambilipitiya.

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference Number : 3/6/2016/10-80. Ministry of Land Reference Number: 4-3/7/2016/HW/129. I hereby cancelled the section that includes Lot No. 80 under Sub section 74 of Section 7 of the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1996/03 dated 05.12.2016 of the Sri Lanka Democratic Socialist Republic. It is hereby inform the general public under Section 7 of the Acquisition Act, that Lot No. 02 of the Main Plan No. 2421 will be included in lieu of the above 1. Lot No. 02 Claimant: The State; Extent: 0.3831Hectare. All parties or their authorized representatives, who have been authorized in writing who have any right, claim or servitude etc. to the above land may call over at my office in 12.09.2019 at 10.00 a.m. at Polgahawela Divisional Secretariat. In addition, I should be informed on or before 31.08.2019 in writing with 2 copies of their status of right/servitude to claim compensation of the said land and the amount of compensation with its calculation. D. ANOMA DISSANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Polgahawela. At the office of the Divisional Secretary, Polgahawela. 10th July, 2019. 08-221
